segments.name: retail consumer banking
segments.description: Provides residential mortgage lending and deposit products to retail customers in the United States.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single reportable segment that derives revenues primarily by providing residential mortgage loans and deposit products to customers in the United States.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay interest on loans, and the bank also earns fees, gains on loan sales and service charges.
revenueModel.evidence: The Association's revenues are derived primarily from interest on loans and, to a lesser extent, interest on interest-earning deposits in other financial institutions, deposits maintained at the FRS, federal funds sold, investment securities, including mortgage-backed securities and dividends from FHLB of Cincinnati stock.
